description: A district registrar must certify a senior's graduation eligibility and authorize the final transcript update after a routine audit identifies unresolved academic-record items, with input from the student's department chair, attendance coordinator, and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: A graduating senior's preliminary transcript audit has three unresolved record items involving a capstone course, attendance recovery, and transfer or dual-enrollment credit.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Brooks has authority to certify graduation eligibility and authorize the final transcript update.
shared_context.S3: The district requires the registrar to verify unresolved audit items with the staff members responsible for those records before certifying a senior.
shared_context.S4: The senior's graduation certification deadline is Friday at 4:00 p.m.

PF1.text: Mr. Imani reviewed the student's capstone portfolio against the district rubric and recorded a passing result worth exactly 1 credit; the signed rubric is in his department file but has not yet been uploaded to the student-information system.

PF2.text: Ms. Novak confirmed that the student completed the district's required attendance-recovery sessions, so the attendance audit status must be recorded as exactly 'complete'; her completion sheet has not yet been attached to the audit record.

PF3.text: Mr. Silva matched the college transcript to the district equivalency guide and confirmed exactly 3 dual-enrollment credits that count toward graduation; the college transcript is filed in counseling but has not yet been entered in the student-information system.

acceptance_conditions: The student must be certified as graduation eligible.
Exactly 1 capstone credit must be awarded.
The attendance-recovery status must be recorded as complete.
Exactly 3 dual-enrollment credits must be accepted.

decisive_facts.why: The capstone review changes the transcript from an unresolved capstone item to exactly 1 awarded credit.
The attendance completion sheet changes the audit status from unresolved to exactly 'complete'.
The equivalency review changes the accepted transfer-credit total to exactly 3 dual-enrollment credits and supplies the required cited basis for that entry.
